title: Michael Kobori (former Starbucks + Levi's Chief Sustainability Officer) on Aspen Summit's Incorruptible theme
summary: Michael Kobori — former Chief Sustainability Officer at Starbucks and Levi Strauss & Co. — captures the emergent theme from Eric's Aspen Business & Society Summit keynote in an IPO-inflated moment: how to design companies that deliver long-term societal value alongside sustainable returns.
blockquote: In an age of astonishing IPO valuations, one theme that emerged was how to design companies that deliver long-term value to society alongside sustainable returns for investors.
attribution_title: Former Chief Sustainability Officer, Starbucks and Levi Strauss & Co.
